description: Source code implementing string buffer routines for managing dynamic string data, including initialization, resizing, appending, and freeing memory.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Handles fatal errors by printing an error message and aborting execution.

methods.name: strbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes a string buffer with a specified length.

methods.name: strbuf_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new string buffer.

methods.name: debug_stats
methods.description: Prints debug information about the string buffer if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: strbuf_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the string buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_free_to_string
methods.description: Returns the buffer as a string and frees the buffer if dynamic.

methods.name: calculate_new_size
methods.description: Calculates the new size for the buffer during resizing, with exponential growth.

methods.name: strbuf_resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to accommodate a specified string length.

methods.name: strbuf_append_string
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to the buffer, resizing as needed.
